limits: the GBA slot, display capture, the main-memory display FIFO, EXMEMCNT's slot ownership and wait states are not modelled; cartridge encryption is not involved (the image is the plaintext the bus delivers)
modelled_registers: 0x008-0x05F engine A backgrounds, affine, windows, mosaic, blending (ARM9)
0x1C0-0x1C3 SPI: power management, firmware, touch screen (ARM7)
0x400-0x51F sound channels, mixer and capture status (ARM7)
0x600-0x6A3 GXSTAT, RAM_COUNT, test and matrix results (ARM9)
0x1008-0x105F engine B backgrounds, affine, windows, mosaic, blending (ARM9)
name: nds_io

register_blocks.name: 2D engine A (display control, backgrounds, windows, blending)

statement: DS I/O for both CPUs: IME/IE/IF, IPCSYNC and the IPC FIFOs, timers (prescaler, count-up), DMA (immediate, V-blank, H-blank, start of display, cartridge per ready word, geometry FIFO), the ARM9 divider and square root, the cartridge bus (B7 block reads served from the ROM image, B8 chip ID), DISPSTAT/VCOUNT with the H-blank flag, KEYINPUT/EXTKEYIN, HALTCNT, POSTFLG, and the dispatch to the video, SPI, save chip, clock, sound and 3D cards. Every other register is latched (reads return the last write) and every register touched is recorded for the coverage report; an entry of modelled_registers marked (ARM7) or (ARM9) counts for that CPU only. Region 4 beyond the registers reaches no register whatever its width: the ARM7's wireless hardware (0x04800000-0x04FFFFFF) is hardware/nds_wifi, reached as halfwords (counted in wifi_accesses); everything else there reads 0.
